channel.title: World Stock News | Real-Time Stock Market News & Financial Intelligence
channel.description: Institutional-grade stock market coverage, Wall Street analysis, real-time macroeconomic reports, and cryptocurrency intelligence.

item.title: ‘We had the worst fight’: I want my husband to retire at 65, but I don’t want to lose his $280,000 salary. Is that unreasonable?
item.dc:creator: World Stock News Editorial Desk
item.description: “We have $2.6 million, most of it in his 401(k) and IRAs, plus $450,000 in a brokerage account.”

item.title: Lutnick faces questions over Nvidia spy scandal. His sons' firm has ties to the chipmaker
item.dc:creator: World Stock News Editorial Desk
item.description: Jensen Huang’s resignation as Nvidia CEO has brought renewed scrutiny to Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick and his family's financial ties to the chipmaker.

item.title: China’s hottest stocks these days have one thing in common: names that sound like sheep
item.dc:creator: World Stock News Editorial Desk
item.description: Shares of fish processors, lighting manufacturers and appliance makers have soared ahead of the Year of the Sheep. Investor appetite has had little to do with the status of their businesses.

item.title: Nvidia is gearing up for one of Wall Street’s most anticipated earnings calls in years
item.dc:creator: World Stock News Editorial Desk
item.description: Jensen Huang’s sudden departure has made Tuesday’s earnings call “the most important in the company’s history.”

item.title: Will the Anthropic IPO create a disturbance in the broader U.S. equity market, like SpaceX did?
item.dc:creator: World Stock News Editorial Desk
item.description: SpaceX’s offering coincided with the June peak in semiconductors.

item.title: Hourly Market Pulse: Global Indices Trade With Steady Breadth as Volume Accelerates
item.dc:creator: World Stock News Editorial Desk
item.description: Mid-day institutional trading patterns reflect disciplined risk management and rotational inflows into cyclical leaders and technology infrastructure.

item.title: SpaceX successfully catches Starship rocket in huge milestone for the space industry
item.dc:creator: World Stock News Editorial Desk
item.description: The historic first gets SpaceX closer to “rapid reusability” of rockets.

item.title: I’m 63 and spending $95,000 on a roof deck for my $500,000 home. Is that a good investment?
item.dc:creator: World Stock News Editorial Desk
item.description: “I have a net worth of $2.3 million and my only debt is a 15-year mortgage.”

item.title: I inherited $1.4 million from my father. Am I wrong to ask my husband of 25 years for a postnuptial agreement?
item.dc:creator: World Stock News Editorial Desk
item.description: “He has always said he wants his daughter to inherit a chunk of his estate, and I’ve never objected to that.”

item.title: ‘He calls my plans a fantasy’: My husband says we can’t afford a $200,000-a-year retirement. Is he being cheap?
item.dc:creator: World Stock News Editorial Desk
item.description: “We have $2 million saved in our retirement accounts and a house worth $1.3 million.”

item.title: ‘I’m sick of flying’: I paid for priority boarding, but the overhead bins were full. Was I duped?
item.dc:creator: World Stock News Editorial Desk
item.description: “Maybe next time I’ll try the other approach: I’ll board whenever I feel like it and drop my suitcase in the first open slot I see.”

item.title: ‘It leaves me with a sour taste’: My elderly mother gave our cousin $800 for a car repair. Should I be worried?
item.dc:creator: World Stock News Editorial Desk
item.description: “I know older people can easily feel patronized, and I don’t want that to happen.”

item.title: My older brother, who has no children, cut our only sister out of his will. I’ll get everything. Do I tell her?
item.dc:creator: World Stock News Editorial Desk
item.description: “I’m torn between respecting my brother’s wishes and being fair to my sister.”

item.title: U.S. air travel could take days to recover after FAA’s lifting of rare nationwide ground stop
item.dc:creator: World Stock News Editorial Desk
item.description: Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin says “zero evidence” of cyberattack, while high jet-fuel costs mean fewer flights available to travelers seeking to rebook.

item.title: How Nvidia turmoil and a Democratic Congress could reshape the AI trade, according to ETF experts
item.dc:creator: World Stock News Editorial Desk
item.description: ETF experts say Nvidia’s leadership turmoil and Democratic control of Congress could shift AI demand to the benefit of other Big Tech stocks, rival chipmakers.
